report_discrepancies.note: Street Fund schedule: printed Total Receipts 119,944 but the printed lines (15,041 + 435 + 757 + 67,198 + 29,970) add to 113,401. The governmental statement (p4) shows Special Revenue Fund other general receipts 36,513 vs street assessment 29,970, so a 6,543 receipt line is missing from the schedule. Digits re-read.

Street Fund schedule: printed Total disbursements 63,902 but the printed lines (9,316 + 600 + 3,157 + 44,108) add to 57,181. The statement (p4) shows Streets 19,704 + capital outlay 44,108 + other capital outlay 90 = 63,902 for this fund. Digits re-read.

notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p4, Total Governmental Funds column); it rolls fund balance (300,638 -> 441,221), so beginning_cash is null (no beginning cash printed) and ending_cash is the p3 cash lines (all assets are cash). Identity: 300,638 + 406,159 - 265,576 = 441,221. Statement p4 prints Streets 19,704 (Special Revenue Fund) and Park 86,884 (General Fund), consistent with the departmental schedules; the Statement of Activities (p2) and budget schedule (p8) instead label 86,884 as street/public works and 19,704 as culture and recreation; p4 labels used. Statement 'Property' 191,893 is the sum of the fund schedules' property tax, homestead, credits, pro rate, carline and motor vehicle tax lines; kept as one printed line. Business-type: Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6), single 'Proprietary Fund' column; 702,924 + 725,779 - 656,829 = 771,874. Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3; totals equal the government-wide 441,221), business-type lines from p1; ARPA restricted is zero and skipped. Detail: departmental schedules for General Fund (department columns General/Fire/Park), Street Fund and proprietary funds (per fund column); Debt Service Fund schedule (p12) has only zero lines (beginning/ending 4,633) and is not recorded. The Budgetary Comparison Schedule (pp7-8) covers the same funds at function level and is not recorded (no double counting). Zero cells skipped. Read pages 1-14 of 14
